verdict.rationale: HubSpot supports natural-language interaction primarily via AI features like plain-language report building ('describe the report you need in plain language') and AI agents (prospecting agent, content creation), plus an MCP server letting any MCP-compatible agent read/write CRM data with natural-language-driven tool calls. However, most of the core product (contacts, deals, workflows, imports) is still operated via UI/API/CLI rather than direct natural-language commands within HubSpot itself. missing for 10: evidence of a native in-app chat/command interface for broad CRM operations, independent hands-on validation of natural-language commands actually working, and clarity on how comprehensive the NL coverage is across all objects/workflows.
